decisionToInform: For a frozen Veilwild candidate, decide whether the current observation interaction/cue/recovery design is ready for another production iteration or needs owner-correct repair before broader Human testing.

upstreamBindings.relationship: raw runtime telemetry supplies condition-bound behavior/event evidence but never Human perception/experience truth

claimSpecificQuestions.claimStatement: Under the frozen candidate and declared input condition, a participant can discover/use the explicit observation interaction rather than assuming proximity alone is sufficient.
The participant can use at least one declared cue class to form/revise a search hypothesis without being given the current creature location.
After at least one pre-success evasion/loss, the participant can continue the same session and attempt reacquisition without developer intervention or process restart.
For the exact participant/build/condition only, camouflage leaves a usable but non-trivial search experience rather than obvious locator behavior or practical invisibility.
claimSpecificQuestions.transportScope: single-participant pilot only; no population prevalence, fairness, or general detectability inference

evidenceSubject: real Human participant external to all A01-A25 Agent roles

targetPopulationAndContext.firstPilot: One adult keyboard/mouse PC user not involved in Veilwild implementation is preferred for apparatus qualification. If only a developer/involved user participates, label the result DEVELOPER_CONDITIONED_PILOT and do not transport it as target-player evidence.
targetPopulationAndContext.platform: PC desktop/laptop under the frozen build condition
targetPopulationAndContext.sessionHorizon: single first-session attempt, approximately 8-15 minutes without padding
targetPopulationAndContext.language: use a language the participant can understand; if the build/protocol locale is not admitted, record as a limitation rather than self-activating Localization E2E

required: can operate the admitted input device or uses an admitted accessibility alternative
avoidForFirstPilot: current A01-A25 Agent outputs presented as Human evidence
participant who already knows exact creature location/encounter solution unless explicitly labeled as expert/developer pilot

conditionFreeze.materialConditionChangeRule: If build, input, audio, accessibility, or encounter condition changes materially during the session, mark the evidence condition-broken and do not silently pool pre/post-change evidence.

method.sessionStyle: moderated observational pilot with minimal intervention after launch
beforeLaunch: Explain that this is a game prototype evaluation, participation is voluntary, and the participant may stop at any time.
Explain what data will be retained: local runtime telemetry, observer notes, and optional brief post-session responses; do not request direct identifiers for the R1 evidence package.
Verify input/audio/accessibility condition and freeze build/protocol identity.
Do not reveal current creature location, solution path, raw state labels, or cue answers.
duringPlay: Do not coach normal search/observe/recovery decisions after launch.
Record only protocol/technical interventions separately with reason and time.
Allow participant to stop at any time.
If a crash/softlock/telemetry integrity failure occurs, preserve the failure as evidence and terminate or restart only as a new condition/run.
postSessionProbes: What told you where to look or where not to look?
What did you think the observation action required?
When the creature moved or escaped, what did you think had happened and what did you try next?
Which cues felt useful, confusing, too obvious, or impossible to notice?
Was there any point where you did not know what action was possible next?

measuresAndObservations.definition: Whether/how the participant initiates explicit observe before any successful observation commitment.
monotonic difference from session_started to first cue_exposed; measures opportunity timing, NOT perception.
post-session account of which cue(s) informed search and how; qualitative, not inferred from telemetry.
after evade_started, whether participant continues into a reacquisition attempt without developer coaching/process restart.
whether an explicit observation commitment occurred under the frozen run; mechanical outcome only.
observer-recorded point where participant cannot identify a plausible next action or the product contradicts its cue/feedback semantics.
participant description of search tension/clarity/obviousness; exploratory single-participant self-report only.

analysisPlan: Verify telemetry manifest/raw SHA-256 and sequence/condition integrity before interpreting any Human session.
Align observer notes and participant probes to monotonic event sequence where possible; do not infer perception from event availability.
Treat one pilot as defect discovery/apparatus qualification, not prevalence or population-effect measurement.
Contradictions between telemetry, observation and participant report are retained as evidence, not averaged away.

decisionRules.condition: participant cannot discover/execute intentional observe because controls/feedback are missing or misleading
decisionRules.decision: route owner-correct repair to A25/A02/A17 as evidence indicates before claiming Human-ready closure

decisionRules.condition: pre-success evade leaves no understandable/reachable same-session reacquisition path
decisionRules.decision: route composite failure to A13/A14/A02/A17; V-H2 remains INCONCLUSIVE/CONTRADICTED for recovery claim

decisionRules.condition: cue opportunity exists mechanically but participant reports/behaves as if no usable cue exists
decisionRules.decision: do not call telemetry wrong by identity; route hypothesis to cue carrier/A02/A22 and retest changed build

decisionRules.condition: telemetry integrity, build identity, or protocol condition binding fails
decisionRules.decision: Human evidence package is inadmissible for product standing; preserve as apparatus failure and rerun only after repair

decisionRules.condition: one pilot completes loop and reports positive experience
decisionRules.decision: may support a case-specific pilot finding only; fun/immersion/fairness/population detectability remain unestablished

stopConditions: telemetry/build/protocol identity failure makes continued evidence non-comparable
target first-session window is exceeded without useful further evidence; record non-completion rather than coaching to success

evidencePackage.directIdentifiers: omit from R1 evidence package unless separately necessary/authorized
evidencePackage.retention: retain only as long as necessary for the declared evaluation purpose and current project evidence needs; deletion/retention policy must be explicit before collecting identifiable data

reopenConditions: different target population or accessibility condition
different input/audio/display condition that could affect the claim
new evidence contradicts prior pilot finding
externalAuthorityNotes: ISO 9241-11:2018 current definition makes usability conditional on specified users, goals and context of use; this protocol freezes those dimensions rather than treating usability as a build-global scalar.
ISO 9241-210:2019 remains current and supports iterative Human-centred evaluation throughout the system lifecycle.
ICO guidance on purpose limitation and data minimisation motivates the R1 choice to avoid direct participant identifiers in runtime telemetry when they are not necessary for the evaluation purpose.
